text:
maria: Thinking through a fast, auditable flow for SIEM extracts where certain fields need KMS-unwrapping for incident triage. Putting a draft here for feedback.

devon: Outline please — who requests, approves, where the keys live, and TTLs?

maria: Draft flow: oncall raises ticket -> requestor picks redacted|raw -> security oncall approves -> proxy mints ephemeral grant -> proxy unwraps in-memory -> DLP scan -> upload to temp s3 with KMS encrypt -> file TTL 24h -> metadata (ticket, fields, hmac, approver) stored 90d in audit-db.

sam: A few quick Qs: 1) who mints ephemeral role? 2) how do we ensure no plaintext lands on laptops? 3) where is the justification stored?

alex: access-proxy (same service used for ephemeral DB creds) mints the role. Unwrap only inside the proxy container; never write plaintext to disk. Justification is a structured audit event (kinesis -> splunk) + persisted metadata row (immutable).

maria: Agree. KMS key policy: allow access-proxy to Decrypt but require CreateGrant per-ticket and immediate RevokeGrant after upload. Include encryptionContext with ticket id.

compliance: Regulators require a schema of exported fields and retention justification. We cannot keep raw export longer than necessary; metadata retention 90d OK but ensure auditors can see the export hash and approver. Also add legal-hold pointer in runbook.

maria: Plan: file TTL 24h, metadata row with {ticket, fields, approver, reason, hmac, expiry, redaction_pref} persisted 90d, encrypted at rest and authz-restricted to auditor role.

devon: RBAC proposal: two roles — oncall_exporter (request only) and export_admin (approve + trigger grant). Approvals require SAML group membership + 2FA. Exports must set redaction_pref on request.

jordan: DLP needs to run in proxy pipeline. For triage we can run permissive scan and flag PII; if PII found then auto-mask unless approver checked include_raw and provided strong justification. I can add a quick rule-pack for SIEM extracts.

maria: Good. We'll add a checkbox in the ticket template: Redaction preference: [redacted|include_raw] and require short justification when include_raw chosen.

security-bot: [audit] export_request_created id=E-2427773333 ticket=INC-9001 requester=@maria

oncall_lead: Ops request: allow a "redacted-only" fast path that short-circuits approval to a single oncall approver for urgent triage. Should be in runbook.

maria: I'll make that an explicit option: redacted_fastpath -> single approver required; include audit annotation explaining reduced checks.

devon: Implementation note: use AWS KMS CreateGrant with GrantTokens scoped by encryptionContext={ticket:INC-9001}; call RevokeGrant after upload and after we've validated upload hash in metadata.

alex: Proxy should do: 1) receive request + ticket id 2) obtain ephemeral IAM role 3) call KMS.Decrypt with grant token inside container 4) DLP scan 5) mask if needed or escalate 6) upload encrypted file to s3-temp using KMS encrypt 7) emit audit events & write immutable metadata row 8) revoke grant & expire role.

compliance: Metadata must include an HMAC of the file and the HMAC key stored in KMS-protected secret store. Auditor role must be able to see metadata but not raw key material. Also add an immutable flag to metadata rows.

sam: Sample ticket template for runbook: ```Request type: SIEM extract (ephemeral) Ticket id: INC-9001 Requester: @user Reason: short summary Redaction preference: [redacted|include_raw] Fields requested: list Approver: @user TTL for file: 24h```

maria: Action items: 1) devon: proto IAM + grant flow 2) alex: proxy changes (in-memory unwrap, DLP hook, upload + revoke) 3) devex: ticket template + redacted checkbox 4) compliance: metadata schema + retention 5) security: structured audit events for every step.

security-bot: [audit] export_request_approved id=E-2427773333 approver=@devon

oncall_lead: Any objections to 24h file TTL + 90d metadata window?

compliance: No objections. Add legal-hold instructions and escalation path to runbook.

jordan: I'll produce a minimal DLP rulepack and a quick validation checklist for oncall.

maria: I'll draft the runbook PR and a strawman IAM policy. Posting timeline: PR by EOD tomorrow, proxy prototype next sprint. Filing RFC and linking this thread. cc @devon @alex @compliance @jordan :eyes:
